html:
Unique Research · Industry insight · March 6, 2024 · Author (CN): Pu Qing

By year-end 2023 the AIGC concept sector index closed at 1,568.50, up 73.51% — a clear vote of confidence (and optimism) on AIGC’s path. More than two-thirds of names in the board rose in market cap; standout gainers cited include Hongbo Shares (鸿博股份), Wondershare (万兴科技), and Zhongke Information (中科信息) — spanning LLM R&D, AI services, and text-processing platforms.

New listings

2023 saw AIGC-board newcomers such as Parallel Tech (并行科技) (HPC / intelligent-compute cloud), Huaxin Yongdao (华信永道) (housing-fund / bank information systems), and Weston (威士顿) (smart manufacturing / big data) — fresh float supply and a signal of sector vitality. Other IPOs Unique Research flags as AIGC-adjacent color: Haikan Shares (internet research / audiovisual new media), Deerma, Santai Shares, Kangliyuan, Yidao Information — home appliances, cross-border e-commerce, fitness gear, smart hardware.

Takeaway

Strong concept-stock performance plus an active IPO pipeline underscore secondary-market attraction. As tech and addressable markets expand, AIGC should keep drawing capital — but investors still need to weigh long-cycle industry trends and company fundamentals, not only headline returns. Secondary dynamics are both a decision input for investors and a health check for the industry.

1 CN image; attach on ingest. Editor (CN): Qiuping.

— END —
